messages:
maria: FYI — NYFin asked for a customer-specific instruct variant for their Q2 pilot. Requirements: 64k context, finance-tuned instruct behavior, int8 PTQ profile, and strict hallucination guardrails. Can we draft a bring-up checklist?

sanjay: ack. Do we have a base we can branch? last known good is base-32k-v3. If we reuse, positional embeddings need extending for 64k.

jen: we can extend RoPE/ALiBi. Need unit tests and regression harness for tokenizers (PDF→OCR differences too).

sam: product prioritization: 1) parity vs base for generation quality, 2) hallucination/safety, 3) perf (latency/cost), 4) stability at longctx.

lia: draft checklist suggestion:
1) Intake: NDA + dataset upload + redaction rules confirmed.
2) Variant plan: start from base-32k-v3 → fine-tune instruct on NYFin corpus (domain prompts).
3) Positional handling: bump to 64k, run embedding drift & overlap tests.
4) Quant: PTQ int8 sweep (and AWQ if available) across 8k/16k/64k truncations.
5) Evals: build eval suites: financial QA accuracy, hallucination detection, temporal consistency for market dates.
6) Benchmarks: p50/p95/p99 latency and cost at 2k/8k/32k/64k prompt+context sizes.
7) Rollout: canary 1% → 10% → 100% with auto-fallback to base-32k if regression detected.
8) Monitoring: per-request trace (prompt hash), cost/latency/safety signals, alerting thresholds.
9) Repro: snapshot training config, seeds, artifact manifest.

sanjay: add: positional unit tests (wrap-around/overlap), tokenizer round-trip checks, and embedding similarity thresholds.

quant-bot: PTQ sweep queued: job_id=64271. ETA ~6h. Collect: perplexity delta, generation similarity (embedding-based cosine + custom financial fidelity score).

jen: for hallucination stress tests, include: long-chain arithmetic, time-shifted market questions (e.g., "What was stock X on 2019-03-15?"), multi-step reasoning about trades, and regulatory citation checks.

maria: ops deploy config sample for bring-up:
```
model: nyfin-instruct-v1
context_window: 65536
quant: int8_ptq
fallbacks:
  - base-32k-v3
routes:
  - region: us-east-1
    priority: dedicated
```

sam: question — do we bill NYFin for dedicated longctx GPUs? product said yes, need billing SKU in rollout notes.

lia: billing SKU candidate: rdinfer.longctx.64k.dedicated — lia to confirm with finance and add cost model to eval doc.

maria: action items:
- @sanjay: pos-emb + drift tests by EOD tomorrow
- @jen: mock eval harness + hallucination stress set by Fri
- @sam: rollout plan + billing SKU confirmation
- @lia: verify NDA & dataset upload flow
- @ops-bot: reserve dedicated bring-up slot (2x A100 80GB)

ops-bot: booked bring-up slot #BRNG-982 for 2026-04-07 09:00 UTC. Assigned: eng-ml.

sanjay: starting pos-emb patch now, will post diff here when ready.

jen: seeding eval harness with 200 finance QAs + 50 long-doc scenarios (PDFs). Will add OCR tokenization tests.

maria: also add rollout kill-switch: if hallucination score degrades >5% vs base on canary, instant rollback.

lia: noted — will add to monitoring runbook and pager thresholds.

sam: I'll draft the canary config (traffic ramp, metric windows, rollback rules) and attach billing table.

maria: thanks all — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
